tsa-a14-v02.quick_english: It is expanded, determined from the Tantrāloka.

tsa-a14-v04.quick_english: Having done the samaya-ending rite on the third day, let him worship the group-sacrifice in the trident-lotus mandala; therein let him worship the outer-retinue, the door-deity-wheel outside; then from the mandala's front-part, beginning at the Aiśa-corner up to Agneya, in row-order — Gaṇapati, guru, paramaguru, parameṣṭhin, former-teachers, the yoginī-wheel, Vāgīśvarī, Kṣetrapāla — let him worship.

tsa-a14-v05.quick_english: Then, taking the fitting command, having placed the whole path from trident-root up to white-lotus, let him worship; then in the middle trident's middle-axis the Goddess Śrīparābhaṭṭārikā with Bhairavanatha, in the left-axis likewise Śrīmadaparā, in the right-axis Śrīparāparā, in the right trident's middle Śrīmadaparā, in the left trident's middle Śrīparāparā — two each in their own places.

tsa-a14-v06.quick_english: Thus by all-place-enshrinement of the Goddess, all becomes complete from her enshrinement — thus.

tsa-a14-v07.quick_english: Then in the middle-trident's middle-axis, let him worship the whole deity-wheel up to the lokapāla-missile by non-difference-alone; from its enshrinement, worshipped everywhere.

tsa-a14-v08.quick_english: Then in pot, kalasa, mandala, fire and own-self — by non-difference-contemplation let him join the five-grounds' conjunction; then by enrichment of the Lord two-nature-juice, flowers and rest, special-worship let him do.

tsa-a14-v09.quick_english: Why bother? Complete with satisfaction-food-offering, without wealth-deception — let him make the sacrifice-place.

tsa-a14-v10.quick_english: In non-being wealth, the great-mandala-sacrifice is not to be done — indeed.

tsa-a14-v11.quick_english: And living animals let him offer.

tsa-a14-v12.quick_english: They too become graced thus — by compassion in the animal-rite one should not doubt.

tsa-a14-v13.quick_english: Then in fire, having satisfied the Supreme-Lord by sesame-ghee and rest, before him another animal for vapa-hom let him do; the deity-wheel let him satisfy by its fat; again the mandala let him worship; then approaching the Supreme-Lord, contemplating the self all-non-different-whole-six-path-complete, the disciple placed in front let him make.

tsa-a14-v14.quick_english: In indirect initiation, of-living-dead-form, let him contemplate him in front, or establish a likeness made of darba-cow-dung-and-rest in front.

tsa-a14-v15.quick_english: Such a disciple — sprinkled with offering-vessel-drops, worshipped by flowers and rest — having done, the whole path in his body let him place.

tsa-a14-v16.quick_english: Then thus let him consider: for the enjoyment-seeker, the auspicious — let him not cleanse.

tsa-a14-v17.quick_english: For the liberation-seeker, the auspicious-and-unauspicious — both even.

tsa-a14-v18.quick_english: In the seedless, the covenant-nooses also let him cleanse; she is to-be-done for near-death, even most-foolish — thus the Supreme-Lord's command; and for him, from mere devotion-faith to teacher-deity-fire, attainment.

tsa-a14-v19.quick_english: Herein, everywhere, habit-capture is indeed the distinguishing [factor], by habit-conformity of mantras — from that-and-that work-doing.

tsa-a14-v20.quick_english: Thus having traced habit-distinction, by main-mantra-consideration-special, the whole path in-own-body-located, by Siva-two-nature-contemplation let him cleanse.

tsa-a14-v21.quick_english: Thus in order, from foot-thumb up to twelve-end, of the disciple whose body-consciousness is made non-different from self-body-consciousness, attained — right-there, in the lake of infinite bliss, in the essence of freedom-sovereignty, in the Lord of the wheel of deities full of all will-knowledge-action-power, bearing all paths, in the mandala of world-being mere-consciousness-residue — by union in such form with the disciple-self, having-become-one, rest let him cause-to-attain; thus non-different from the Supreme-Lord he becomes.

tsa-a14-v22.quick_english: Then if an enjoyment-seeker there be: where just in-tattva his enjoyment-desire becomes, right-there by whole-and-scattered-manner let him join.

tsa-a14-v23.quick_english: Thereafter, for residual-function, from the Supreme-Lord's-nature, suddenly having-emerged, made-of-pure-tattva body for him let contemplate — thus this all-noose-releasing initiation.

tsa-a14-v24.quick_english: Then the disciple the guru by fees, as-before, let worship.

tsa-a14-v25.quick_english: Then in fire the disciple's rite let him do: the Sri-Para-mantra — of-so-and-so, so-and-so tattva I-purify — thus ending-with-svaha, per-tattva three oblations; at-end complete ending-with-vausad.

tsa-a14-v27.quick_english: For the enjoyment-seeker, in the enjoyment-place, for-yojanika-sake one [offering]; another for-pure-tattva-creation-sake, one-more.

tsa-a14-v28.quick_english: Then worship of the guru by fees — thus this child-initiation.

tsa-a14-v29.quick_english: In-which ongoing one [tattva] — having-excluded past and future — act is purified.

tsa-a14-v01.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v01.question: What is announced?
premises: Now the child-initiation rite.
tsa-a14-v01.inference: The topic: putrakadīkṣāvidhi — child-initiation rite declared.

tsa-a14-v02.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v02.question: How is it sourced?
premises: It is expanded, determined from the Tantrāloka.
tsa-a14-v02.inference: The rite's expansion derives from Tantrāloka — authority by derivation.

tsa-a14-v03.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v03.question: How is it presented here?
premises: But it is stated condensed.
tsa-a14-v03.inference: Condensed restatement (saṃkṣipta) for this manual's use.

tsa-a14-v04.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v04.question: What is the third-day mandala-worship order?
premises: Samaya-ending rite on the third day; group-sacrifice in trident-lotus mandala; outer-retinue + door-deity-wheel outside; from Aiśa-corner to Agneya in row-order: Gaṇapati, gurus, parameṣṭhin, former-teachers, yoginī-wheel, Vāgīśvarī, Kṣetrapāla.
tsa-a14-v04.inference: The pūjā-krama: three-day samaya-close, then sequential deity-installation from Aiśa to āgneya.

tsa-a14-v05.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v05.question: Where do the three Parās stand?
premises: Whole path placed trident-root to white-lotus; middle-axis Śrīparābhaṭṭārikā with Bhairavanatha, left Śrīmadaparā, right Śrīparāparā; right-trident-middle Śrīmadaparā, left-trident-middle Śrīparāparā — two each in their own places.
tsa-a14-v05.inference: The triśūla-axis placement of the three Parā-deities (bhagavatī + Bhairavanātha + apāra-parā pairs), each on its axis.

tsa-a14-v06.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v06.question: What does all-place-enshrinement do?
premises: Thus by all-place-enshrinement of the Goddess, all becomes complete from her enshrinement — thus.
tsa-a14-v06.inference: Tathāvidha sarvasthāna-adhiṣṭhātṛtva: everything becomes pūrṇa from the Goddess's enshrinement.

tsa-a14-v07.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v07.question: What of the middle-axis wheel?
premises: Then in the middle-trident's middle-axis, whole deity-wheel to lokapāla-missile worshipped by non-difference-alone; from its enshrinement, worshipped everywhere.
tsa-a14-v07.inference: The devatā-cakra on the middle axis is worshipped abhinnatayā; its enshrinement extends pūjā everywhere.

tsa-a14-v08.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v08.question: What is the five-ground conjunction?
premises: In pot, kalasa, mandala, fire, own-self — by non-difference-contemplation join the five-grounds; then special-worship by the Lord two-nature-juice's flowers and rest.
tsa-a14-v08.inference: Pañcādhikaraṇa-saṃdhi: five vessels joined by abhedabhāvanā, then viśeṣa-pūjā with puṣpādi enriched by parameśvara-advaya-rasa.

tsa-a14-v09.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v09.question: Why is wealth-deception excluded?
premises: Why bother? Complete with satisfaction-food-offering, without wealth-deception — let him make the sacrifice-place.
tsa-a14-v09.inference: The yāgasthāna must be tarpaṇa-naivedya-paripūrṇa and vitta-śāṭhya-virahita — no fraud in funding.

tsa-a14-v10.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v10.question: When is the great-mandala-sacrifice forbidden?
premises: In non-being wealth, the great-mandala-sacrifice is not to be done — indeed.
tsa-a14-v10.inference: Mahā-maṇḍala-yāga requires actual wealth (asati vitte); without it, na kartavya eva.

tsa-a14-v11.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v11.question: What about animals?
premises: And living animals let him offer.
tsa-a14-v11.inference: Jīvataḥ paśūn nivedayet — living animals are offered (the paśu-rite licensed).

tsa-a14-v12.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v12.question: Why not doubt the animal-rite?
premises: They too become graced thus — by compassion in the animal-rite one should not doubt.
tsa-a14-v12.inference: Kāruṇikatayā: even paśus are anugrītā — the rite benefits them; no doubt (na vicikitset).

tsa-a14-v13.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v13.question: What follows the paśu-offering?
premises: Fire: Supreme-Lord satisfied by sesame-ghee; another animal for vapa-hom; deity-wheel satisfied by its fat; mandala worshipped again; approaching the Lord, contemplating self all-six-path-complete, the disciple placed in front.
tsa-a14-v13.inference: The vapa-homārtha sequence: saṃtaraṇa → paśu-vapa → devatā-cakra-tarpaṇa → maṇḍala → parameśvara-vijñāpana → self-contemplation → disciple placed.

tsa-a14-v14.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v14.question: What is contemplated for parokṣa-dīkṣā?
premises: In indirect initiation, of-living-dead-form, contemplate him in front — or establish a darba-cow-dung likeness in front.
tsa-a14-v14.inference: Jīvan-mūrta or pratikṛti: the (dead) disciple contemplated or represented before the rite.

tsa-a14-v15.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v15.question: How is the disciple prepared?
premises: Such a disciple — sprinkled with offering-drops, worshipped by flowers — the whole path placed in his body.
tsa-a14-v15.inference: Argha-pātra-prokṣaṇa + puṣpa-pūjā, then samastam adhvānaṃ taddehe nyaset — path installed in the disciple's body.

tsa-a14-v16.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v16.question: What does the teacher consider for a bhogecchu?
premises: Then thus let him consider: for the enjoyment-seeker, the auspicious — let him not cleanse.
tsa-a14-v16.inference: For the bhogeccha, the śubha is NOT to be purified (na śodhayet) — desire left intact.

tsa-a14-v17.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v17.question: What about the mumukṣu?
premises: For the liberation-seeker, the auspicious-and-unauspicious — both even.
tsa-a14-v17.inference: For mumukṣu both śubha-aśubha are handled (ubhayam api) — full purification.

tsa-a14-v18.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v18.question: What is the nirbījā rule?
premises: In the seedless, covenant-nooses also cleansed; she is for near-death, even most-foolish — the Lord's command; attainment for him by mere teacher-deity-fire devotion-faith.
tsa-a14-v18.inference: Nirbījā dīkṣā cleanses samaya-pāśas even for mūḍha (Lord's ājñā); siddhi by guru-devatā-agni-bhakti-niṣṭha alone.

tsa-a14-v19.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v19.question: What distinguishes the mantras?
premises: Herein everywhere habit-capture is the distinguishing [factor], by habit-conformity — from that-and-that work-doing.
tsa-a14-v19.inference: Vāsanā-grahaṇam is the bhedaka: mantra-efficacy follows vāsanā-conformity (tattatkārya-kāritva).

tsa-a14-v20.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v20.question: How is the whole path cleansed?
premises: Having traced habit-distinction, by main-mantra-consideration-special, the path in-own-body, by Siva-two-nature-contemplation.

tsa-a14-v21.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v21.question: What is the disciple's transformation?
premises: From foot-thumb to twelve-end, disciple-body-consciousness made non-different from self-body-consciousness — right-there, in infinite-bliss-lake, freedom-sovereignty essence, Lord of the deity-wheel, world-manḍala — by union in such form with disciple-self, one becomes, rest attained; thus non-different from the Lord.
tsa-a14-v21.inference: The climax: pāda-aṅguṣṭha-to-dvādaśānta identity-attainment — śiṣya-caitanya abhinnī-kṛta with self-caitanya, viśrānti in the anantānanda-sarovara — parameśvara-abhinna bhavati.

tsa-a14-v22.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v22.question: How is an enjoyment-seeker joined?
premises: If enjoyment-seeker: where in-tattva his desire becomes, right-there by whole-and-scattered-manner join.
tsa-a14-v22.inference: Bhogeccha-tattva-yojana: join at exactly the tattva where desire stands, samasta-vyasta-tayā.

tsa-a14-v23.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v23.question: What is the final body?
premises: Thereafter for residual-function, from the Lord's nature, suddenly emerged, made-of-pure-tattva body contemplate — thus this all-noose-releasing initiation.
tsa-a14-v23.inference: The śeṣa-vṛtti body: jhaṭiti-prasṛta, śuddhatattva-maya — this dīkṣā is the samasta-pāśa-vyojikā.

tsa-a14-v24.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v24.question: How does the disciple close?
premises: Then the disciple the guru by fees, as-before, let worship.
tsa-a14-v24.inference: Guru-pūjā with dakṣiṇā, pūrvavat — the closing courtesy.

tsa-a14-v25.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v25.question: What is the disciple's fire-rite?
premises: In fire the disciple's rite: Sri-Para-mantra — so-and-so's so-and-so tattva I-purify — ending-with-svaha, three oblations per tattva, complete ending-with-vausad at end.
tsa-a14-v25.inference: The śiṣya-homa: pratitattva tri-āhuti with svāhānta, pūrṇā vauṣaḍantā — per-tattva purification formula.

tsa-a14-v26.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v26.question: What completes the tattva-purification?
premises: Thus Siva-end-tattva-purification; then by-yojanika-told-order full-offering.
tsa-a14-v26.inference: Śivānta-tattva-śuddhi closed, then pūrṇāhuti by the yojanika-described order.

tsa-a14-v27.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v27.question: Which offerings for which seeker?
premises: For the enjoyment-seeker, in the enjoyment-place, for-yojanika one [offering]; another for pure-tattva-creation, one-more.
tsa-a14-v27.inference: Two pūrṇāhutis: bhogeccha's for yojanā in bhoga-sthāna; the other for śuddhatattva-sṛṣṭi.

tsa-a14-v28.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v28.question: How does the rite end?
premises: Then worship of the guru by fees — thus this child-initiation.
tsa-a14-v28.inference: Guru-dakṣiṇā-pūjana closes: ity eṣā putrakadīkṣā — the rite names itself at the end.

tsa-a14-v29.speaker: Teacher (putraka-dīkṣā)
tsa-a14-v29.question: What gets purified?
premises: In-which ongoing one [tattva] — having-excluded past and future — act is purified.
tsa-a14-v29.inference: The seal: vartamāna-eka-varjita-bhūta-bhaviṣyat-karma-śuddhi — ongoing tattva purified of past/future acts.

tsa-a14-v04.plain_english: Having done the samaya-ending rite on the third day, let him worship the group-sacrifice in the trident-lotus mandala; therein let him worship the outer-retinue, the door-deity-wheel outside; then from the mandala's front-part, beginning at the Aiśa-corner up to Agneya, in row-order — Gaṇapati, guru, paramaguru, parameṣṭhin, former-teachers, the yoginī-wheel, Vāgīśvarī, Kṣetrapāla — let him worship.
tsa-a14-v04.sanskrit_cite: samayyantaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā tṛtīye 'hni triśūlābje maṇḍale sāmudāyikaṃ yāgaṃ pūjayet tatra bāhyaparivāraṃ dvāradevatācakraṃ ca bahiḥ pūjayet tato maṇḍalapūrvabhāge aiśakoṇāt ārabhya āgneyāntaṃ paṅktikrameṇa gaṇapatiṃ guruṃ paramaguruṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ pūrvācāryān yoginīcakraṃ vāgīśvarīṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca pūjayet

tsa-a14-v05.plain_english: Then, taking the fitting command, having placed the whole path from trident-root up to white-lotus, let him worship; then in the middle trident's middle-axis the Goddess Śrīparābhaṭṭārikā with Bhairavanatha, in the left-axis likewise Śrīmadaparā, in the right-axis Śrīparāparā, in the right trident's middle Śrīmadaparā, in the left trident's middle Śrīparāparā — two each in their own places.
tsa-a14-v05.sanskrit_cite: tata ājñāṃ samucitām ādāya śūlamūlāt prabhṛti sitakamalāntaṃ samastam adhvānaṃ nyasya arcayet tato madhyame triśūle madhyārāyāṃ bhagavatī śrīparābhaṭṭārikā bhairavanāthena saha vāmārāyāṃ tathaiva śrīmadaparā dakṣiṇārāyāṃ śrīparāparā dakṣiṇe triśūle madhye śrīparāparā vāme triśūle madhye śrīmadaparā dve tu yathāsvam

tsa-a14-v06.plain_english: Thus by all-place-enshrinement of the Goddess, all becomes complete from her enshrinement — thus.
tsa-a14-v06.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sarvasthānādhiṣṭhātṛtve bhagavatyāḥ sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ tadadhiṣṭhānāt bhavati iti

tsa-a14-v07.plain_english: Then in the middle-trident's middle-axis, let him worship the whole deity-wheel up to the lokapāla-missile by non-difference-alone; from its enshrinement, worshipped everywhere.
tsa-a14-v07.sanskrit_cite: tato madhyaśūlamadhyārāyāṃ samastaṃ devatācakraṃ lokapālāstraparyantam abhinnatayaiva pūjayet tadadhiṣṭhānāt sarvatra pūjitam

tsa-a14-v08.plain_english: Then in pot, kalasa, mandala, fire and own-self — by non-difference-contemplation let him join the five-grounds' conjunction; then by enrichment of the Lord two-nature-juice, flowers and rest, special-worship let him do.
tsa-a14-v08.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ kumbhe kalaśe maṇḍale agnau svātmani ca abhedabhāvanayā pañcādhikaraṇam anusaṃdhiṃ kuryāt tataḥ parameśvarādvayarasabṛṃhitena puṣpādinā viśeṣapūjāṃ kuryāt

tsa-a14-v09.plain_english: Why bother? Complete with satisfaction-food-offering, without wealth-deception — let him make the sacrifice-place.
tsa-a14-v09.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ bahunā tarpaṇanaivedyaparipūrṇaṃ vittaśāṭhyavirahito yāgasthānaṃ kuryāt

tsa-a14-v10.plain_english: In non-being wealth, the great-mandala-sacrifice is not to be done — indeed.
tsa-a14-v10.sanskrit_cite: asati vitte tu mahāmaṇḍalayāgo na kartavya eva

tsa-a14-v11.plain_english: And living animals let him offer.

tsa-a14-v12.plain_english: They too become graced thus — by compassion in the animal-rite one should not doubt.
tsa-a14-v12.sanskrit_cite: te 'pi hi evam anugṛhītā bhavanti iti kāruṇikatayā paśuvidhau na vicikitset

tsa-a14-v13.plain_english: Then in fire, having satisfied the Supreme-Lord by sesame-ghee and rest, before him another animal for vapa-hom let him do; the deity-wheel let him satisfy by its fat; again the mandala let him worship; then approaching the Supreme-Lord, contemplating the self all-non-different-whole-six-path-complete, the disciple placed in front let him make.
tsa-a14-v13.sanskrit_cite: tato 'gnau parameśvaraṃ tilājyādibhiḥ saṃtarpya tadagre 'nyaṃ paśuṃ vapāhomārthaṃ kuryāt devatācakraṃ tadvapayā tarpayet punar maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet tataḥ parameśvaraṃ vijñapya sarvābhinnasamastaṣaḍadhvaparipūrṇam ātmānaṃ bhāvayitvā śiṣyaṃ puro 'vasthitaṃ kuryāt

tsa-a14-v14.plain_english: In indirect initiation, of-living-dead-form, let him contemplate him in front, or establish a likeness made of darba-cow-dung-and-rest in front.
tsa-a14-v14.sanskrit_cite: parokṣadīkṣāyāṃ jīvanmṛtarūpāyām agre taṃ dhyāyet tadīyāṃ vā pratikṛtiṃ darbhagomayādimayīm agre sthāpayet

tsa-a14-v15.plain_english: Such a disciple — sprinkled with offering-vessel-drops, worshipped by flowers and rest — having done, the whole path in his body let him place.
tsa-a14-v15.sanskrit_cite: tathāvidhaṃ śiṣyam arghapātravipruṭprokṣitaṃ puṣpādibhiś ca pūjitaṃ kṛtvā samastam adhvānaṃ taddehe nyaset

tsa-a14-v16.plain_english: Then thus let him consider: for the enjoyment-seeker, the auspicious — let him not cleanse.
tsa-a14-v16.sanskrit_cite: tata itthaṃ vicārayet bhogecchoḥ śubhaṃ na śodhayet

tsa-a14-v17.plain_english: For the liberation-seeker, the auspicious-and-unauspicious — both even.

tsa-a14-v18.plain_english: In the seedless, the covenant-nooses also let him cleanse; she is to-be-done for near-death, even most-foolish — thus the Supreme-Lord's command; and for him, from mere devotion-faith to teacher-deity-fire, attainment.

tsa-a14-v19.plain_english: Herein, everywhere, habit-capture is indeed the distinguishing [factor], by habit-conformity of mantras — from that-and-that work-doing.

tsa-a14-v20.plain_english: Thus having traced habit-distinction, by main-mantra-consideration-special, the whole path in-own-body-located, by Siva-two-nature-contemplation let him cleanse.

sections.FUNCTION: States the putrakadīkṣā: mandala-installation, Parā-placement, five-ground joining, paśu and wealth rules, disciple preparation and identity-attainment, seedless and habit-mantra doctrine, fire-rites, and the self-naming close.
sections.KEY TERMS: putrakadīkṣā (child-initiation); trirāsa-placement (the three Parās on axes); pañcādhikaraṇa (five-ground join); paśu-vidhi (animal-rite with compassion); nirbījā (seedless initiation); vāsanā-grahaṇa (habit-capture as bhedaka); abhinnī-kṛta-caitanya (disciple-self identity); pūrṇā-huti + vauṣaḍ (the closing offerings).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 14 condenses the Tantrāloka putraka-dīkṣā material; the identity-climax (u21) echoes a12's samāveśa logic; feeds nothing later — a self-contained rite-manual.
sections.BOUNDARY: Animal-offering and wealth-rules stated as rite, no ethical commentary; nirbījā's grace for mūḍha attributed to parameśvara-ājñā, not argued; habit-mantra doctrine asserted in one verse (u19-20) without expansion.
sections.EXPLANATION: The rite proceeds: authority (Tantrāloka → condensed), installation (third-day mandala + Parā-axes + five-ground join), eligibility rules (wealth required, animals offered with compassion), preparation (disciple sprinkled, path placed in his body), climax (identity-attainment foot-thumb-to-twelve-end, rest in the bliss-lake), then the seedless/habit-mantra doctrine, fire-rites, offerings, and the self-naming close. Each step is imperative-ordered — the manual's form is its argument.
